entries.text: Everyone has a KPI page with completed work, on-time rate, overdue items, open workload and cycle time. Leaders and supervisors also see their department, managers their division, and directors the whole company.
Supervisors, managers and directors have one Approvals page for every completion and department request they need to decide, across all the departments they oversee.
You can request work from another department. Its supervisor or manager accepts it, and only then does it become a work item. You can follow your requests and see why one was declined.
Work items can be made private. Only the assignees, the person who created it, their direct superiors and super admins can see it.
New Leader level between Staff and Supervisor. Leaders can assign and edit the work of the staff in their department.
Branches. Plant Cilegon has its own divisions and departments under a Branch Director, who sits between Manager and Secretary and looks after that branch only.
Admins can choose which departments may post in Announcements, and every announcement is also emailed. You can switch these emails off in your notification settings.
Wiki folders can have an editor list. Only those people can add or change material there, and everyone else can still read it.
The Needs attention cards on Home let you approve, reject, change state, reply and mark as read without leaving the page.
A finished work item can no longer be edited by anyone. Superiors and admins can reopen it first.
Nobody can assign work to their own superiors. Assignee lists only show people you are allowed to assign.
The activity timeline shows the newest first. You can change this in your preferences.
Directors' overdue counts and stats only include work created by supervisors and above.
The personal Paradise chat room has been removed. Notifications still reach your inbox and email.
Deleting comments, links, sub-items, relations and quick links now asks for confirmation.
Switching to another tab or window no longer refreshes the page.
Opening a chat marks it read straight away, and the sender sees the read tick within a second.
Chat cards for comments and mentions show the text instead of raw formatting code.
The chat message list no longer scrolls underneath the message box.
